name: Winter squash

schedule.notes: Only if your season is short. Cucurbits hate root disturbance — start in big peat pots.
Two seeds per hill, thin to one strongest.
Wait for hard rind that resists thumbnail. Cure 10 days at 80 F for storage.

harvest.cues: Skin is dull and hard, stem is brown and corky. Cut with 2 in of stem attached.
harvest.storageNotes: Cure 10 to 14 days warm and dry, then store at 50 to 55 F. Butternuts last 6 months.

varieties.name: Butternut
varieties.notes: Best storage of the lot. Resistant to vine borer.

varieties.name: Delicata
varieties.notes: Edible skin. Sweet, faster than most. Doesn't store as long.

varieties.name: Kabocha
varieties.notes: Dense, dry-fleshed Japanese pumpkin. Excellent for roasting.

notes: Needs space — vines run 10 to 15 ft. Direct-seed if possible; transplant only if you must.
